tour_name: Mendenhall Glacier Helicopter Tour & Guided Walk
description_short: Helicopter flightseeing + glacier landing for a guided walk on the ice (weather-dependent).
description_long: This is a classic Juneau “big swing” excursion: a turbine helicopter flight over rainforest and icefield terrain, landing on glacier ice for a guided walk. Plan conservatively—helicopters are sensitive to visibility and wind, and logistics include briefing + gear time.
inclusions: Transport may be included depending on booking channel
requirements: Ability to walk on uneven/icy terrain
Follow operator weight and safety rules
Weather can cancel—have a backup plan
